citeAs: Victoria, M., & Andresen, G. B. (2019). Photovoltaic time series for European countries and different system configurations [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.2613651
description: This dataset contains 38 years of hourly time series data representing photovoltaic (PV) capacity factors for every European country, including the EU-28 and neighboring countries such as Serbia, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Norway, and Switzerland. The capacity factor is defined as the ratio of actual power delivered to the total installed PV capacity. Countries are identified using their ISO-3166-3 codes, and the data spans from 1979 to 2017. The PV capacity factors were derived by converting solar irradiance data from the Climate Forecast System Reanalysis (CFSR) dataset into electricity generation values aggregated at the country level. Before conversion, irradiance data was bias-corrected using the satellite-based SARAH dataset and a globally applicable methodology, both detailed in the linked article. For each country, four different time series are provided, representing alternative PV system configurations: rooftop, optimum tilt, two-axis tracking, and delta configurations. Users can combine these series using different assumptions about the share of each configuration to create weighted, aggregated capacity factor time series.
name: Photovoltaic EU
